name: Anna Anatolyevna Popova
source:
A foreign exchange student from Russia. Ever since Kou guided her through school orientation, she has fallen head-over-heels for him. Her hobbies include tracking Kou’s location via GPS and observing Kou’s bathroom habits through hidden cameras. Despite these slight idiosyncrasies, she is the school council president and an ex-field operative.

[From [url=http://homuha.weebly.com/]official site[/url]]
